list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase before this guide was written. Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; the hidden flags (28 hidden) and the progress targets PlayStation tracks are as PSNProfiles publishes them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap stages in order and it will unlock last, as the capstone of the whole list. It cannot be missed: every other trophy on the list is earnable in one playthrough, and the platinum follows from them. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; our own roadmap from the official descriptions.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. This is one of the first missions of Chapter 1, so it pops early in any playthrough. Story mission trophies cannot be missed — just keep playing the story in order. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter closes, so there is no special step — play the story through and it unlocks on its own. It cannot be missed. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it pops when the chapter ends and cannot be missed — keep following the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. It cannot be missed — it is awarded for story progress alone. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. It cannot be missed — it is awarded for story progress alone. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story — the last mission of the last chapter. This is the story's gold trophy and it pops at the credits. It cannot be missed. Before you start it, finish any time-sensitive side content you care about (see the missables page), because the final mission closes the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies pop when the mission ends, so play it through to its conclusion; there is no optional objective to chase. It cannot be missed. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed — it is awarded for finishing a story mission. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed — it is awarded for finishing a story mission. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed — it is awarded for finishing a story mission. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed — it is awarded for finishing a story mission. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed — it is awarded for finishing a story mission. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — PlayStation tracks this one as a count out of 100. This is the long grind behind the platinum: work through the game's completion checklist (story, activities, collectibles and the counted trophies on this list) and the percentage climbs with it. Nothing on the completion checklist is missable, so take it at your own pace after the story; use the per-trophy counts in this guide to see what is left. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 100-point target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/100) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — PlayStation tracks the count, so use the progress box in this guide to keep a running total. Any stunt counts toward the 250, so fold them into normal play: jumps, near misses and airtime while driving between missions all add up, and a dedicated session of repeated jumps finishes the rest. It cannot be missed; stunts stay available after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 250 target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/250) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — PlayStation tracks the count out of 9. Work through the activities this guide lists (races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling and the rest) and tick each type off as you sample it; one try each is enough, no wins or high scores needed. It cannot be missed; activities stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 9-activity target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/9) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PlayStation tracks the count, so this is a long grind, not a single visit. Return to the ranges between missions and clear a few challenges at a time; gold on every one is the requirement, so expect to replay the harder ones until the medal lands. It cannot be missed; the ranges stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 42-challenge target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/42) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations — PlayStation tracks the count, so one win per location is the goal, not 14 wins at one spot. Visit each location in turn and race until you win there, then move on. It cannot be missed; the races stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 14-location target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/14) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — PlayStation tracks the count, and the word 'different' is the catch: winning the same race twice counts once. Race a spread of events across Leonida and tick each new win off; 20 distinct wins is the target. It cannot be missed; races stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 20-race target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/20) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the game's activities, so find a fishing spot, take the challenge against Cal and out-fish him; if you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win. It cannot be missed; fishing stays available after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any arcade game, start to finish. Pick the one you find easiest and play it through; there is no score target in the description, just a completion. It cannot be missed; arcades stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's mission strand. Side-character strands unlock as you play the story; take Andy's missions whenever they appear and keep going until his last one ends. It cannot be missed — side strands stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's mission strand. Take Kenton's missions as they appear during and after the story and keep going until his last one ends. It cannot be missed — side strands stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's mission strand. Take Billy's missions as they appear and keep going until his last one ends. It cannot be missed — side strands stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — PlayStation tracks the count out of 8. Stranger strands are the side quests marked by strangers around the map; finish a whole strand, not just its first mission, for it to count. Explore the state, pick up strands as you find them, and keep a tally in this guide. It cannot be missed; stranger strands stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 8-strand target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/8) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's mission strand. Take Randy's missions as they appear and keep going until his last one ends. It cannot be missed — side strands stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's mission strand. Take Tyrone's missions as they appear and keep going until his last one ends. It cannot be missed — side strands stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — PlayStation tracks the count, so tick each spot off as you find it. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: this is the one trophy other guides flag as potentially missable. The first meditation spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and is reported to become unavailable after that chapter, so meditate there the first time it is offered and do not put it off. Later spots need both protagonists playable together, which opens up as the story advances. Do every spot the moment it appears and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter as a safety net. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 18-spot target as published by PSNProfiles; the missable warning as reported by PowerPyx (via GTA Zone's trophy list).
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/18) as published by PSNProfiles; missable warning as reported by PowerPyx, via GTA Zone.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting quests open up as the story advances; take the hunt, track the animal and bring it down. The exact animal is not pinned down in the official description, so follow Bret's prompts in-game rather than a fixed location — the trophy pops when the hunt for his unique animal is done. It cannot be missed; the hunt stays available after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — PlayStation tracks the count out of 3. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets, not just stray cards, since only finished sets count. Sweep each area as you explore and keep a tally in this guide. It cannot be missed; cards stay collectible after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 3-set target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/3) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — PlayStation tracks the count out of 100. WAiNK It is the game's photo-tagging collectible: find a location, frame it and tag it, then move on to the next. Work through Leonida area by area so you do not re-tag the same spots, and use the progress box here to keep count. It cannot be missed; locations stay taggable after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 100-location target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/100) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — PlayStation tracks the count out of 50. Challenges are the game's small objectives spread across activities and the open world; they accumulate naturally as you play, so pick off the easy ones first and let the rest come with the other trophies on this list. It cannot be missed; challenges stay completable after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 50-challenge target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/50) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it and escape. Do it somewhere with fast getaway options: raise the heat with your partner present, then break line of sight, get out of the search area and stay hidden until the stars clear. The trophy pops when you escape, not when the wanted level starts. It cannot be missed — try again as often as you like. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level — the trick is the 'without losing it' part: the wanted level must stay active through all three robberies. Pick three shops close together, plan the route, rob one after another quickly, and keep moving so the police do not catch you between stops. If the stars clear or you are caught, start the run over. It cannot be missed. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — PlayStation tracks the count out of 100. Vehicles are discovered by finding (and scanning) them around Leonida, so the total grows as you explore: new districts, car parks, garages and traffic all hold new models. Make a habit of scanning every unfamiliar vehicle you pass and the count climbs on its own. It cannot be missed; vehicles stay discoverable after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 100-vehicle target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/100) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with at least five enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends — pick a busy shootout rather than a quiet one, and use a weapon that kills quickly. If you only get four, the count resets, so retry the same kind of fight. It cannot be missed. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. In plain terms from the description: leave the airport by air without a schedule, i.e. take an aircraft and fly out of VCIA yourself. Timing note (inference, unconfirmed): the description reads like a one-off moment tied to the airport, so try it while the airport is freely accessible and do not assume it will still be open late in the story — keep a manual save before you attempt it. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the timing note is our own inference from the description, not a confirmed fact.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; timing note is our own inference from the description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke with a hint: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' A Rhino is the game's tank, so this trophy is about doing something notable in (or with) a Rhino tank — expect it to pop from tank combat, such as taking out enemies while driving one. The exact trigger is not spelled out in the official description, so treat the tank as the clue and experiment in a Rhino once you can get one. It cannot be missed as far as the description shows. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the Rhino reading is our own inference from the description's wording.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the Rhino reading is our own inference from the description.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole requirement: plan the approach, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — slip away and try another store or the same one again. It cannot be missed. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — PlayStation tracks the count out of 5. Each vault needs a robbery and a clean getaway, so bring a fast escape vehicle and a route out before you go in. Five successful vault jobs is the target; a failed escape does not count. It cannot be missed; vaults stay robbable after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 5-vault target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/5) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take its cargo and get away before the police close in. A fast car parked nearby for the getaway makes the escape far easier. One successful truck robbery and escape is all it takes. It cannot be missed. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — PlayStation tracks the count out of 52 areas. The map clears as you visit each of its 52 areas, so the trophy is a sightseeing tour: drive, fly or sail into every corner of the state, including the islands and the far counties, until the whole map is uncovered. Use the progress box here to track the areas you have visited. It cannot be missed; the whole map stays explorable after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 52-area target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/52) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — PlayStation tracks the count out of 9 gangs. One operation per gang is the requirement, so spread the jobs across all nine gangs rather than hitting the same gang's operations twice. Keep a tally per gang in this guide and tick each one off as its operation is robbed. It cannot be missed; gang operations stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 9-gang target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/9) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is the whole instruction: go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and have a cocktail there. Timing note (inference, unconfirmed): the name 'In The Beginning…' reads like a moment tied to the start of the game, so try it early — the first time you can reach Ocean Beach — and do not assume the moment will still be there later. Keep a manual save before you attempt it. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the timing note is our own inference from the description, not a confirmed fact.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; timing note is our own inference from the description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description is the whole instruction: get a vehicle inside a showroom and drive it straight out through the glass, in the classic style the name winks at. Timing note (inference, unconfirmed): the description reads like a one-off moment tied to a specific showroom visit, so try it the first time you are inside a showroom with a vehicle and keep a manual save before you attempt it. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the timing note is our own inference from the description, not a confirmed fact.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; timing note is our own inference from the description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — in other words, go bowling there and play a game through. The description names the alley, so head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl; the trophy is about the follow-through, so finish the game you start. It cannot be missed; the alley stays open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague: 'A partnership with mass appeal.' The word 'partnership' points at the two protagonists doing something together that wins a crowd over — a shared moment in the story or an activity done as a pair. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the official description, so treat this as a story-moment trophy: keep playing with your partner and it should pop from a shared scene. It cannot be missed as far as the description shows. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the reading is our own inference from the description's wording.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the reading is our own inference from the description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices — PlayStation tracks the count out of 500. The description is terse on purpose, but the count tells the story: this is a long-run tally of decisions made across the whole game, not a single event. Play normally, make choices whenever the game offers them, and the number climbs; there is no need to chase it specifically until the endgame, when the progress box here shows how far along you are. It cannot be missed; choices keep coming after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 500 target as published by PSNProfiles.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; PSN progress target (0/500) as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle: 'Second time's the charm.' Something in the game needs a second attempt — a failed first try followed by a success. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the official description, so the honest advice is to play on and let it come: retry the things you fail at, and when the second attempt lands, this should pop. It cannot be missed as far as the description shows. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the reading is our own inference from the description's wording.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the reading is our own inference from the description.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description is a reaction, not an instruction: 'What the hell just happened?' This is a strange-encounter trophy — something weird happens somewhere in Leonida and the trophy pops when you witness it. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the official description, so explore odd corners of the map and pay attention to strange sights; it is a discovery trophy, not a checklist one. It cannot be missed as far as the description shows. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the reading is our own inference from the description's wording.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the reading is our own inference from the description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The bowling pun is the hint: drive past a target, lean out and strike them with a melee weapon so they go down like a pin. Line up a slow pass on a lone pedestrian and time the swing; a miss costs nothing, so retry until it connects. It cannot be missed. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — PlayStation tracks the running total out of $250,000. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your contacts to launder them into clean cash, and the total climbs with every job. Keep laundering after every big score rather than letting bills pile up, and watch the progress box here. It cannot be missed; contacts stay available after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the $250,000 target as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — PlayStation tracks the running total out of $100,000. Every purchase in any shop counts, so this climbs on its own as you buy weapons, clothes, vehicles and supplies through the game. If it is the last one standing, spend the surplus cash on the most expensive items you still want. It cannot be missed; shops stay open after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the $100,000 target as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — PlayStation tracks the count out of 8. Garages are bought as property around Leonida; buy each one as you can afford it, saving the expensive ones for the post-story money grind. Eight purchases is the target, so keep a tally in this guide and do not leave one district's garage unbought. It cannot be missed; properties stay for sale after the story. Sources: the official PlayStation trophy description as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase; the 8-property target as published by PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — PlayStation tracks the count out of 10. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one; ten distinct registrations is the target, so vary the vehicles rather than registering the same one twice. It cannot be missed; the app stays available after the story.
